data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Billat total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

in_hebrew.name: בילת
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew root בלט (balat), meaning 'to rush', 'to flow swiftly', or 'to be hasty'. It may be used to describe someone who acts quickly or someone who is always in a hurry.

in_greek.name: Βιλλάτος
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the Hebrew name בילת (Billat). It preserves the original meaning of the Hebrew name, indicating swiftness or hastiness.

in_latin.name: Bilatus
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the Greek name Βιλλάτος (Billatos). It preserves the original meaning of the Greek name, indicating swiftness or hastiness.
